name: 01_testConnection
description: testConnection sync action — mints a token and runs a compute_cost_only metadata query (no quota consumed). Real host/company/creds are deep-merged from secrets.json at record time; the dummy *.medallia.com values here are rewritten to fixed placeholders by the URL sanitizer so replay matches.

name: 02_listFields
description: listFields sync action — one metadata call returning the fields node for UI selection.

name: 03_feedback_incremental
description: Minimal live feedback extract for this customer's datetime schema (finish_date_field_id=e_creationdate, type=datetime). page_size=5 and a ~7-day initial_start_value keep the live blast radius tiny; recording is hard-capped at 2 pages via MEDALLIA_MAX_PAGES.
